title: Operating multiple agents in parallel with the CLI
caption: Three sessions, three stages of one workflow; you orchestrate.
terminalsLabel: Three terminal sessions of one /drive workflow

drive.head: /drive: one workflow, every stage in its own session
drive.body: Agents implement in their own worktrees, you are grilled on the decisions, and a monitor watches the gates; you merge and review once.

talking-points.description: Left: an agent implements a ticket in its own worktree and hands work to a Subagent. Middle: the agent grills me on the open decisions, one question, options and a recommendation. Right: a monitor session watches the others; flightdeck shows context, gates and errors at a glance.
